# Ryan Dynamics

> Ryan Dynamics provides industrial design, electronics, embedded firmware, CAD drafting, and 3D printing services in Newcastle, NSW, Australia.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.ryandynamics.com.au/): Overview of services and selected work.
- [Projects and insights](https://www.ryandynamics.com.au/projects-and-insights/): Project case studies and technical articles.
- [Contact](https://www.ryandynamics.com.au/contact/): Project enquiries and contact form.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.ryandynamics.com.au/privacy/): Privacy information.
- [Website terms](https://www.ryandynamics.com.au/website-terms/): Website use terms.

## Services

- [Electronics](https://www.ryandynamics.com.au/services/electronics/): Custom PCBs, wiring, and specialised equipment electronics.
- [Embedded firmware](https://www.ryandynamics.com.au/services/programming/): Firmware for hardware, interfaces, and control logic.
- [CAD drafting](https://www.ryandynamics.com.au/services/drafting/): Models, drawings, parts, assemblies, and fabrication documentation.
- [3D printing](https://www.ryandynamics.com.au/services/3d-printing/): Printed prototypes and practical parts.
